questions.stem: Select all primary animal tissue types established in histology: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: 4 primary tissues: Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Nervous.

questions.stem: Select all locations containing Simple Cuboidal Epithelium: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Simple cuboidal lines thyroid follicles, salivary ducts, renal PCT, ovary surface.

questions.stem: Which components constitute formed blood elements? (Select all that apply)
Select all characteristics belonging to Skeletal Muscle: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Skeletal muscle is voluntary, syncytial, striated, subject to fatigue.

questions.stem: Which anatomical sites feature Hyaline Cartilage covers? (Select all that apply)
options: A) Articular ends of long bones
answers: A) Articular ends of long bones
questions.explanation: Hyaline cartilage lines bone articular ends, nose, ribs, trachea.

questions.stem: Select all anatomical locations lined by Simple Squamous Epithelium: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Simple squamous lines blood vessel endothelium, mesothelium, Bowman's capsule, and lung alveoli.

questions.stem: Select all functions performed by Epithelial Tissue sheets: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Epithelium protects, absorbs, secretes, and perceives sensations.

questions.stem: Which features characterize Yellow Elastic Connective Tissue? (Select all that apply)
options: B) High elasticity and recoil capacity
C) Found in walls of large elastic arteries
E) Inelastic thick white collagen bundles
answers: B) High elasticity and recoil capacity
C) Found in walls of large elastic arteries
questions.explanation: Elastic CT contains branching elastin fibers giving high elasticity to arteries and vocal cords.

questions.stem: Select all cell types present in nervous tissue organ structures: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Nervous tissue comprises neurones and various neuroglial support cells.

questions.stem: Which formed blood elements lack a nucleus at mature functional stage? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Human RBCs and Platelets are non-nucleated in mature peripheral circulation.
